name: What steps do I need to take to prepare my kitchen before cabinet painting?

mainEntity.name: What steps do I need to take to prepare my kitchen before cabinet painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before we begin painting your kitchen cabinets, we recommend removing all items from inside the cabinets and drawers. Clear countertops of appliances and decor. While we take precautions to protect your home, covering nearby furniture and flooring with drop cloths or plastic sheeting is also advisable. Our team in Daly City and Brisbane will handle the more extensive preparation like masking and surface cleaning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Empty cabinets and clear countertops. Cover nearby furniture and flooring to protect them.
